title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: Architecture settled and rebuild authorized (0111). Audit + design complete and approved (0113-0116). Nothing implemented. Now designing the gate-based review model: how a gate pass earns trust across projects with different test infrastructure.
spine.next_step: Answer delivered on gate trust (capability probe by EXECUTION not config-detection, a coverage manifest, differential gates, per-work-type floors, fail-closed on unmet floor, verify-setup as the human-gated bootstrap, honesty lines fed mechanically into pr-create). Await the user's decision on the five gate-design questions, then start landing-order step 0 (worktree reaper).
open_risks: Second-system effect remains the primary danger (0106); mitigation is 0110 fix-first with a machine-checkable oracle, NOT more reviewers.

12 leaked worktrees / 78 MB are a LIVE TRIPWIRE under step 4 restack (branch checked out blocks branch -f). hermetic-guard-test holds an UNCOMMITTED modified tracked file - needs a human call before anything touches it.
LSP-from-a-CLI-verb is UNPROBED (0116). Running it before the spec is the 0112 rule-3 obligation; skipping it repeats the 0103 mistake.
No timing or token data exists for the current 4,851-line engine. Every improvement claim needs a before-and-after replay of a real cluster set.
Relaunch trigger for end-and-relaunch still UNRESOLVED (0111), the last design gap in 0108.
A gate that cannot fail is worse than no gate (0112); 0107 already caught the suite certifying code that cannot run. Gate coverage must be declared, not assumed.
Write guard holds all .claude/{hooks,rules,lib,workflows} edits for a human, so step 0 cannot proceed unattended.
Six other paused mitosis threads still need explicit per-thread disposition from the user.
Dirty tree on feat/centralized-pr-creation: modified .drift-state.json, a test, mitosis.js; untracked .bak-pre-promptsfix-* twins and three specs.
out_of_scope: Bootstrapping a project's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping a spec - that is verify-setup, human-invoked, one-time.
